forecast_origin_rule: maximum audited C8 canonical evaluation date among main eligible identity-unique pretrained open-weight models with at least one finite task result
time_cutoff_rule: date-only distribution rule: choose the unique model reference-date cutoff that yields at least 10 test models and train fraction closest to 0.80; ties choose earlier cutoff; fixed before score values were read

main_sample_rule.base_table: C2, with C1 used only for equivalence/field audit
main_sample_rule.open_weights: C2 or C4 says Yes and neither source says No
main_sample_rule.license: Hub License present and not unknown/other
main_sample_rule.identity: unique C01/T05 canonical identity, unique C3 Year, unique C4 metadata link, non-ambiguous date
main_sample_rule.time_axis: C8 canonical evaluation date per model-task
main_sample_rule.missing: no imputation of N, D, compute, date, license, or task score
main_sample_rule.other_models: chat/fine-tuned open models estimated only as a separate sensitivity layer

candidate_specs.sensitivity_only: 1 + log10(N_parameters) is reported but never selection-eligible

candidate_selection_rule.rank_and_condition: full rank and standardized condition number < 1e8
candidate_selection_rule.scenario_rule: use validated selected model; if M2 is not validated, still report a separately labelled SCENARIO_ONLY_UNVALIDATED M2 forecast

contribution_rule.selected_model: simplest model passing the frozen upgrade gate; M0 if none
contribution_rule.scale_center: median log10(compute) in +/-365-day endpoint windows; if fewer than 3 records, nearest 3

equations.Delta_non_scale: b_T*(t_origin-t_start), or 0 when the selected model has no time term

scenario_rule.rule: T08-compatible adjacent same-family N/D pairs, 90-730 days, median within family-period, family-equal quantiles; fallback is the pre-registered mathematical multiplier grid
